raw_segments.text: Raskolnikov had a sudden desire to say something exceptionally pleasant to them all.
Excuse me, captain, he began easily, suddenly addressing Nicodem Fomitch, will you enter
I am ready to ask pardon if I have been ill-mannered.
I am a poor student, sick and shattered, shattered was the word he used by poverty.
I am not studying because I cannot keep myself now, but I shall get money.
I have a mother and sister in the province of X they will send it to me, and I will pay.
My landlady is a good-hearted woman, but she is so exasperated at my having lost my lessons
and not paying her for the last four months that she does not even send up my dinner.
And I don't understand this I owe you at all.
She is asking me to pay her on this I owe you how am I to pay her, judge for yourselves.
